thread:
nina.kim: Hey team, Im due mid-Nov and plan to take 14 weeks. Two quick operations Qs: 1) Is the lactation room scheduling handled centrally or should I reserve specific times? 2) I have a performance calibration meeting scheduled during my leave month  how should we handle it so its fair? 3) Also curious about travel reimbursement if I need to fly back early for a pediatric appt.
people-ops: Congrats Nina! :tada: 1) Lactation rooms are managed by Facilities. We recommend reserving recurring slots for the first 8 weeks back so teammates know your windows. If you need priority, we can flag a room as "reserved for parental accommodation" while youre actively pumping.
facilities-bot: Room booking: https://office.redwood.com/rooms. To request a reserved accommodation, email facilities@redwood.com with dates and desired recurrence. Well confirm within 2 business days.
people-ops: 2) For performance reviews during leave, the default is to defer the calibration conversation until your return. If a manager needs to document goals or notes for the review period, well mark the review as "deferred due to leave" and schedule a catch-up within 30 days of return. If you prefer to participate remotely, let your manager know and well arrange the meeting outside of protected leave hours.
people-lead: Nina, Ill move your calibration to the "postponed" bucket and add a note that you are on approved parental leave. We will not downgrade your rating for being absent.
payroll-bot: Reimbursement: short-notice travel for pediatric or medical appointments may be eligible under the parental care stipend policy. Submit receipts to expenses.redwood.com and tag "Parental care travel". Pre-approval recommended for >$500.
nina.kim: Thanks all  Ill ask Facilities to reserve Monday/Wednesday 11:00-12:00 recurring and Im happy to defer the review. One more: will I still accrue vacation while on paid parental leave?
people-ops: Good Q. Vacation accrual continues during paid parental leave per policy. If you opt for unpaid leave beyond paid weeks, accrual pauses during unpaid periods. Well include accrual dates in your approval email.
nina.kim: Perfect, thanks everyone :heart:
